mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments (id, resource_type, resource_id, parent_id, user_id, content, at_users, rating, likes, reply_count, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{parentId}, #{userId}, #{content}, #{atUsers}, #{rating}, 0, 0, 'visible')
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.content, c.likes, c.created_at, u.user_id AS user_id, u.user_name AS user_name, u.avatar AS avatar, IF(cl.comment_id IS NOT NULL, 1, 0) AS is_liked FROM comments c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON c.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN comment_likes cl ON c.id = cl.comment_id AND cl.user_id = #{currentUserId} WHERE c.parent_id = #{parentId} AND c.status = 'visible' ORDER BY c.created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
